name: Offshore Wind Farm Maintenance
mission_theme: Offshore array far from shore: blade inspection, vessel tracking, shipping lane avoidance and a degraded link.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Point inspection of POI-TURBINE-T12 (25 m standoff, 6 images)
tasks.brief: Inspect POI-TURBINE-T12. Hold a standoff of 25 m (tolerance 3 m) at 90 m AGL, aim the gimbal 0 deg down and take at least 6 images per face. Hover at least 12 s at each capture point so the image is stable. Do not enter the 15 m keep-out radius around POI-TURBINE-T12 and keep 40 m from your teammate.
tasks.objective: Inspect POI-TURBINE-T12 from 25 m standoff at 90 m AGL, capture at least 6 images per viewing angle with the gimbal pitched 0 deg down, and hold each capture position for 12 s.

actions: move to the 25 m standoff ring
capture 6 images per angle with 0 deg pitch
check image count and pitch per angle
re-capture any angle short of 6 images

constraints: hover only at declared capture points
no flight below 90 m in the inspection ring
failure_conditions: entering the 15 m keep-out radius
fewer than one complete angle set at task end
loss of link during capture with no recovery

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-ARRAY-N (90% target, 3 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-ARRAY-N completely. Fly parallel tracks at 120 m AGL with 20 % side overlap and keep every UAV 25 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 90 %. Recover to LZ-PLATFORM-B when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-ARRAY-N with 3 UAVs at 120 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 90 % of the block with 20 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 25 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV leaves the geofence
any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes
loss-of-control or collision flag

checkpoints.metric: union coverage of BLOCK-ARRAY-N at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at LZ-PLATFORM-B, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

tasks.title: Grid sampling of GRID-BLADE (15 points, revisit every 10 min)
tasks.brief: Sample the 15 points of the GRID-BLADE grid with the RGB sensor. Every point needs at least 2 samples, taken 10 +/- 2 min apart, and each sample must be geotagged within 5 m. Plan the order so that the revisit interval is respected without waiting on the ground.

actions: order the 15 points into a route that meets the 10 min revisit
hold >= 3 s and take the RGB sample

constraints: hover >= 3 s at every point

tasks.title: Night thermal survey of BLOCK-ARRAY-N (90% target, no RGB)
tasks.brief: It is night and only the thermal payload works. Survey BLOCK-ARRAY-N at 130 m to 90 % coverage, and report every thermal hotspot above 150 degC with its position and peak temperature. The RGB camera must not be used, and no illumination is allowed. Re-visit any hotspot once to confirm it before reporting.
tasks.objective: Survey BLOCK-ARRAY-N at night with the thermal sensor only at 130 m, reaching 90 % coverage and flagging every hotspot above 150 degC.

tasks.title: Mission continuity after losing UAV-1 and UAV-3 at t=1200 s
tasks.brief: At about t = 1200 s, UAV-1 and UAV-3 are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least 60 % of the BLOCK-ARRAY-N work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.
tasks.objective: Keep the mission-critical core of BLOCK-ARRAY-N running after UAV-1 and UAV-3 are lost at t = 1200 s, delivering at least 60 % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.

actions: detect the loss of UAV-1 and UAV-3
report dropped work and residual risk

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s

searching for lost UAVs
no statement within 180 s
